primaryQuestion: Is correct Hebrew agreement available in the exact failing conversation context, and can a localized interference mechanism be repaired without language, grounding or goal regressions?

promotion.interpretation: AI-judged exploratory evidence only; no universal guarantee of no regressions

execution.selection: full-logit CPU path in every matched arm

gates.requires: Valid fixtures, measurements, complete evidence-backed judging and matched inference paths
Shared agent/UI replay, inspect and compare path works with persisted artifacts
Reproducible failure family with evidence of available correct behavior or a local conflicting computation
Localized intervention rescues target decisions and free continuation beyond controls while preserving protected cases
Verified linear-operator weight correction or explicitly labeled activation-only diagnostic
Every required development criterion >=9, target gain and preservation/performance gates pass
Frozen candidate and independent judges satisfy the same gates on fresh families

stopPolicy: No post-result relaxation of gates or budgets. Failed C/E/Q prevents promotion and final evaluation; deliver mechanism_found_not_promotable, inconclusive or invalid_or_blocked with evidence.
